sources.name: adsb.lol
sources.notes: Official docs (api.adsb.lol/docs): "The license for the API as well as all data ADSB.lol makes public is ODbL" (Open Database License v1.0, same as OpenStreetMap). API source code is BSD-3-Clause (https://github.com/adsblol/api). Future API key may require feeding adsb.lol (see README); rate limits are dynamic.
